findings.finding: Eight identical overlapping ordinary Birdeye calls issue eight fake HTTP requests in the publishing parent.
findings.repair: Same-loop ordinary callers share latest owned work; each adapter result remains detached. A force_refresh always owns a new request and normal followers may join it.

findings.finding: An older successful or unavailable response can overwrite a newer forced success with stale data or a negative cache entry.
findings.repair: Latest admitted generation atomically controls cache/backoff publication, across loops/threads; older responses keep their own unchanged receipt but cannot overwrite latest state.

findings.finding: Unqueried expired shared rows and per-key Birdeye/Gecko failure state grow without capacity or retention limits.
findings.repair: Shared TTL/LRU store defaults8192 entries; expiry heap is independently bounded. Birdeye/Dex/Gecko counters each default8192 recent keys, one-hour retention and capped escalation level4, with atomic increments.

findings.finding: The shared async cache loader holds one lock across the entire load, blocking unrelated keys; added coalescence must not introduce orphaned requests or cancellation propagation.
findings.repair: Bounded per-key ownership, separate loop buckets removed when idle, shielded joiners and explicitly owned child cleanup drained under repeated cancellation/timeout. Capacity rejection is unknown, not provider failure or permission to buy.

implementation.cache: Shared default8192 entries with TTL/LRU, expiry sweep on ordinary operations, bounded expiry index max(64,2*capacity), thread RLock and fail-closed backwards/invalid local clock handling. Stored receipts and values are not restamped. Adapters, not the generic cache, own detached-copy/sentinel semantics.
implementation.failures: Birdeye/Dex/Gecko recent-key counters each default8192 with monotonic retention3600s and capped backoff level4; these are not total actual failures or wire/billing counters. Existing success resets and negative TTL thresholds remain. Dex/Gecko malformed TTL settings now parse safely.
implementation.requests: Birdeye defaults16 total owners and256 joiners across active loops; normal exact-context requests coalesce only within one loop. Force callers never join older work. No autonomous loop is added; owner cancellation drains child acknowledgement, which may exceed a caller timeout.
implementation.latest_state: Cache/backoff publication uses latest admitted request generation under one thread lock. Failed/rejected/cancelled work does not fabricate successful evidence. Rejection does not insert a provider-negative cache or failure level.
